data.name: Tiny Train Depot

heroImage.alt: A bustling miniature train station with multiple railway tracks, a steam locomotive, passenger platforms, station buildings, waiting travelers and a coffee cart

data.fullDescription: Tiny Train Depot — a relaxed simulation about a depot with more trains than space. Lay the tracks, plan the schedule and juggle arrivals before a traffic jam happens. Passengers get impatient but forgive you if the coffee cart is nearby. Decorate the station as you grow.
